feeds.title: Toxic Ties
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Lana and welcome to TOXIC TIES - a blog about personal evolution through toxic relationships. If you found your way here, chances are, you have a toxic person in your life. This blog can help you navigate this difficult but empowering journey to freedom from toxic people, relationships, and beliefs.

feeds.title: For Relationship Help Blog
feeds.description: Toxic relationships & narcissism blog, featuring cognitive empathy, emotional manipulation, fear of rejection, anxiety, conflict, C-PTSD, and codependence. Authored by Rhoberta Shaler. Dr. Shaler particularly helps the partners, exes, and adult children of the relentlessly difficult, toxic people she calls Hijackals® to save their sanity and stop the crazy-making.

feeds.title: Jillian Turecki Blog
feeds.description: Jillian Turecki is a certified relationship coach, teacher, and writer who for 20 years has taught others how to transform their relationships with themselves. Wherever you are in your relationship journey - single and hoping to manifest love, in a relationship and struggling, heartbroken, or happily coupled but wanting to go to the next level, THE CONSCIOUS WOMAN will help you.

feeds.title: Unbittered Blog
feeds.description: Healing from a toxic relationship is a process, not an event. Whether the toxic relationship you had was romantic, familial, platonic, or professional. We are here to help you on your healing journey by giving you the inspiration to reach your goals through acts of self-care. We want to help you gather your Strength, Courage, and Wisdom so that you can use the talents and abilities you already possess to Fly and Thrive.

feeds.title: Toxic Relationship Recovery Project Blog
feeds.description: Read the Toxic Relationship Recovery Blog to learn tips to break free from a narcissistic partner and have the healthy relationship you desire.
